items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach/reports. Same left knee that had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year—scary long-term.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery progressing; Raiders/Kubiak optimistic for W2 vs LAC or W3.
items.implication: Monitor practice; TE1 if active. Mayer benefits if out again.

items.text: Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Chargers will monitor how he feels this week before determining availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib issue after hit; status up in air for Week 2.
items.implication: Game-time feel; if out, boosts other LAC WRs/TEs. Monitor Wed-Fri practice.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), team-high 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Solid snap/route/target share immediately upon return from major knee injury.
items.implication: WR1 upside unlocked; start with confidence if healthy moving forward.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, high route and target share in new KC offense.
items.implication: Every-down RB1 with receiving upside; lock in lineups and hold ROS.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty ascends to high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rush attempts, 61% routes into 21% targets, 23 att + 6 targets, 156 scrimmage yds, 2 TDs. Utilization score tied Bijan for #1 at RB.
items.why: Every-down workhorse role in Kubiak scheme with improved OL/YAC; elite prospect pedigree.
items.implication: Lock as RB1 ROS; sell-high only for massive overpay.

items.text: Bucky Irving upgrades to mid-range RB2: 62% snaps, 58% routes (edge over Gainwell), 53% rushes, short-yardage work, 85 utilization. Positive step vs preseason Gainwell hype.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in snaps/routes/short yardage despite early deficit script.
items.implication: Startable RB2; Gainwell holds as RB4 handcuff/pass-down.

items.text: Travis Etienne downgrades to low-end RB2: even with Kamara out, only 43% attempts, 38% routes in three-way committee (snaps 58%). Efficiency good but role murky; Kamara return hurts more.
items.why: Failed to seize lead role in Kamara absence; committee confirmed.
items.implication: Flex/low RB2 only; stash Kamara and re-evaluate post-return.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2.
items.why: Extreme target/carry concentration on core four as expected for high-powered offense.
items.implication: Start the core four with confidence; fade committee/backup Lions skill players.

items.text: Bucky Irving's 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (only 8 carries + rush TD, 21 routes, 7/7 targets) but got sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Strong matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: Goal-line work, route edge over Gainwell, healthy appearance post-camp concerns.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; preferred over Gainwell in TB backfield.
items.opportunity: Only GL carry inside 10; 21 routes vs 13; 7 targets

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/Etienne, 26/Miller, 15/Donaldson; routes 24/7/5; opportunities 18/9/4. Surprised by lack of takeover.
items.why: Committee usage persisted despite Kamara absence; low route share relative to snaps.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further dilutes. Monitor if role expands.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious. Would have returned if playoff game; day-to-day heading into MRI/testing.
items.why: Not serious per sources; optimistic short-term outlook.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or limited; monitor. Minimal long-term concern.

items.text: Weekend reports: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Rome Odunze (calf) EXPECTED TO PLAY; Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED; Malik Nabers (knee) no news yet (later active with strong usage). Sean Tucker doubtful, Josh Williams activated.
items.why: Pre-game expected/not/pending designations; Nabers cleared to play and produced.
items.implication: Love/Odunze startable if active; Kamara absence boosted Etienne (limited); Nabers back.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9 (2.5 last night); just 2 targets (7% share) but routes elite (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks, behind only Worthy 30). Needs serious volume to pay off.
items.why: High route participation but tiny aDOT and low target share in return.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; monitor targets closely, not pure route share play yet.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks. Even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Low passing-game involvement; committee even with injury ahead of him.
items.implication: Limited receiving upside; more pure rusher than three-down back so far.
items.opportunity: 13 routes; Sanders also 13 after Sampson out
